label: Watches your profile's chrome CSS and hot-reloads userChrome.css / userContent.css live on save - no browser restart needed.
Custom Watch Path
description: Absolute path to a file or directory to watch. Leave empty to watch the default profile chrome dir (~/.zen/<profile>/chrome).

label: Poll Interval (ms)
description: How often the file watcher checks for changes.

label: Rebuild Sine mods too
description: Also calls Sine's manager.rebuildMods() so Sine-managed themes refresh in sync.

label: Show a toast on each reload
Hotkey
description: Combo to force a reload anytime (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+F5). Leave empty to disable.
